resolutions: review_run_id = sha256(brief_sha256 + branch_diff_digest) — deterministic, self-verifying, no opaque id store.
branch_diff_digest = committed PRODUCT diff over merge-base(origin/main)..HEAD (excludes .factory/ + plans/); a new branch commit re-grounds it.
Coherence check lives in a shared factory_lib.require_coherent_review_run helper; pr_ready calls it (load_review_artifacts may reuse it) — no inline duplicate.
current_flow: review-brief --all writes .factory/review-briefs/all.md but mints no run id; the three lens artifacts carry no shared run/brief/branch binding, so pr_ready cannot tell whether they are one coherent run over one branch state. committed_paths + WORKFLOW_PATHS exclusion and product_tree_digest already exist for the diff digest.

criteria_map.pr_ready refuses when the three lens art: Inspected pr_ready + load_review_artifacts; the shared require_coherent_review_run(root, reviews) refuses unless all three lenses echo one review_run_id/brief_sha256/branch_diff_digest and branch_diff_digest == current committed product diff.

new_abstractions: factory_lib.branch_diff_digest(root) and require_coherent_review_run(root, reviews) plus a review-run token; justified as the single seam review-brief mints, record_review echoes, and pr_ready enforces.
